title: INTENT-AS-A-TOOL Makes it Easy to Track Agentic Misalignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.27348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous agents, safety failures increasingly involve consequential actions. We study agentic misalignment, where agents take harmful actions under goal conflicts and pressures. Using chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring, we find that harmful execution is often preceded by intent signals in reasoning. However, post-hoc CoT labels are too coarse to show how intent changes during generation. We introduce INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, an approach that adds intent-targeted tools to give the model a dedicated channel for expressing commitment to a target behavior. The probability of calling an intent tool provides a judge-free, fine-grained signal of the model's tendency to pursue that behavior. Our results show that INTENT-AS-A-TOOL complements CoT monitoring, expands post-hoc CoT labels into dense trajectories, and identifies critical steps for online intervention. translated_title: 意图即工具：轻松追踪代理性错位
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）被部署为自主代理，安全故障越来越多地涉及具有后果性的行动。我们研究了代理性错位，即代理在目标冲突和压力下采取有害行动的情况。通过链式思维（CoT）监控，我们发现有害执行往往在推理过程中有意图信号的前兆。然而，事后CoT标签过于粗糙，无法显示生成过程中意图的变化。我们引入了“意图即工具”（INTENT-AS-A-TOOL）方法，该方法添加了针对意图的工具，为模型提供专用通道来表达对目标行为的承诺。调用意图工具的概率提供了一种无需评判的、细粒度的信号，指示模型追求该行为的倾向。我们的结果表明，INTENT-AS-A-TOOL补充了CoT监控，将事后CoT标签扩展为密集轨迹，并识别出在线干预的关键步骤。这些发现表明，行动偏好可以用于早期检测和干预代理性错位。
tldr: 本文提出“意图即工具”方法，通过为模型添加意图专用工具，利用工具调用概率提供细粒度的无评判信号，以追踪和干预代理性错位。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, which adds intent-targeted tools to provide a judge-free, fine-grained signal via tool-call probability for tracking and intervening in agentic misalignment.
